page_title: TOU 1-2 MON | Toulouse v Monaco 20/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Fine attempt! Vanderson (Monaco) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
90+3' Vanderson (Monaco) is penalised for a foul. Jerome Brisard had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90+2' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) tries to bend in the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall makes an easy block.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Here is a change. Wissam Ben Yedder is going off and Adi Hutter gives the last tactical orders to Myron Boadu (Monaco).
88' The referee allows time for a substitution. Aron Donnum will be replaced by Mamady Bangre (Toulouse).

86' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
84' Naatan Skytta (Toulouse) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
81' Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse) sends a chip pass into the box, but Philipp Kohn is quickest to intercept the ball.
79' A cross into the box from Naatan Skytta (Toulouse) is cleared.
78' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Cristian Casseres is replaced by Naatan Skytta (Toulouse).
76' Referee Jerome Brisard halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Adi Hutter, then shows him a yellow.
74' It's time for a substitution. Krepin Diatta (Monaco) comes on in place of Takumi Minamino.
74' Toulouse can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

73' An accurate cross finds its way to Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) who sends in a bullet header towards the middle of the target from just outside the box. The ball bounces up off the ground but the goalkeeper saves.
72' A pass into the penalty area from Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is intercepted by the defence.
71' The resulting set piece from Toulouse is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
71' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it. Toulouse win a corner.
70' Frank Magri (Toulouse) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
69' Toulouse take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
67' Carles Martinez has decided to make a change. Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) replaces Christian Mawissa Elebi.
67' The manager makes a subsitution with Ibrahim Cissoko (Toulouse) coming on for Cesar Gelabert Pina.
67' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the left post!
66' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
66' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
65' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Cesar Gelabert Pina (Toulouse).

63' Edan Diop (Monaco) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
62' Corner kicks – 1:5.
59' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
58' Toulouse have been awarded a free kick from long distance, it won't be a direct shot.
57' It's a yellow card for Edan Diop (Monaco).
56' The referee signals a substitution. Edan Diop (Monaco) is brought on as a substitute for Folarin Balogun.
55' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom right corner, but Philipp Kohn is equal to it and makes an easy save.
52' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
52' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
51' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) can have an early bath after being sent off by the referee for a tackle that simply has no place in football!

51' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the bottom right corner. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
50' The ball is out of play. Monaco will have a chance to score from a corner.
50' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Cesar Gelabert Pina (Toulouse), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
49' The ball is cleared after Vanderson (Monaco) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
48' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Philipp Kohn comes off the line to clear the ball away.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' The Monaco players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
45+2' This is a yellow card! Logan Costa (Toulouse) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' 1 - 2 Goal! Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Guillaume Restes.
44' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
43' A player from Toulouse takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. Monaco are awarded a penalty kick!
42' Vanderson (Monaco) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
41' Wasted opportunity. Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.

38' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Philipp Kohn, who pulls off a comfortable save!
37' Frank Magri (Toulouse) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
34' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
33' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
31' Monaco work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

31' Vanderson (Monaco) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball is out of play. Monaco win a corner kick.
30' A lofted cross from Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
29' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
26' 1 - 1 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 1:1.
25' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

24' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Guillaume Restes makes a great save to stop his effort. Monaco force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
23' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) serves up a nice cross, but Guillaume Restes punches the ball away.
22' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
21' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
20' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
17' The linesman signals a throw-in for Monaco.
16' A cross from Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
15' Christian Mawissa Elebi (Toulouse) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
14' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) commits a rough challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for an infringement. Monaco will take a free kick near the side line.
11' The corner from Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) is intercepted by the defence.
10' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
8' Logan Costa (Toulouse) is penalised for holding. Jerome Brisard signals a set piece.
8' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
5' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Frank Magri (Toulouse) does well to meet a cross inside the box and strikes a perfect header into the roof of the net.
4' The free kick from long range, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
3' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Monaco will have the kick-off.
Jerome Brisard is introduced as the referee for today's match.
